description: This file defines the LDAPTestService class, which extends LDAPService and provides methods for testing LDAP connections and authentication, including handling LDAP settings and external LDAP adapter interactions.

classes.name: LDAPTestService
classes.description: A service class for testing LDAP connections, implementing connection and authentication testing methods, leveraging LDAP settings and external LDAP adapter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes LDAP settings for the LDAPTestService.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Returns an LDAP adapter instance, creating it if necessary based on the current LDAP settings.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Attempts to bind to LDAP using provided credentials to test the connection.

methods.name: testAuthentication
methods.description: Performs an LDAP connection test and returns success or failure message and status.
